slots.question: A4
slots.title: Five-mark question 4

content.text: Identify the correct generation based on the following descriptions.

a) The production of personal computer marks the main feature of this generation. The price of computer during this period is the lowest compared to the other generation. It provides fast processing ability with less power consumption.
b) Machines that emulate human intelligence which can process and respond to natural language is developed in this generation.
c) In this generation, air condition is no longer required because the heat produced by the machine is reduced. However, fan is needed for heat discharging.
d) Integrated circuit comprises of a number of transistors, resistors and capacitors are invented by Jack Kilby in this generation.
e) Assembly language is introduced during this generation to replace machine language for more reliable and improved performance.
